column1: # Per-scene triage of the corpus differential's two-engine structure differences (fm-5wq.33).
# Read by scripts/corpus_differential.py --report: every differing scene is listed with its label.
# A row whose first difference no longer matches the scene's is reported stale; a row whose scene
# ran in both engines and no longer differs is listed for removal. The corpus is CC BY-NC-SA:
# scene ids and our own words only, never scene source.
